## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Screenshots

Add before-and-after screenshots for visual changes, or write `Not applicable`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated files.
- [ ] Backend and frontend checks pass where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, local databases, uploads, or generated build folders are included.
